subtitle: Cross-check of 04/Oct/2026, the night of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): Polymarket at the confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT (99.59% of polling sections tallied), the nine national polls released on 03/Oct and the press flow of 03 and 04/Oct.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 15.50% (vol USD 16.52M cumulative) in the winner contract, down 20.00pp raw and 19.94pp normalized, confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT. COUNT: 45.06% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied. POLL: he led the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in five of the nine national polls of 03/Oct.
fortes: Led the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in five of the nine national polls of 03/Oct: Datafolha, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), PoderData, CNT/MDA and AtlasIntel, which gives 46.7% to 43.8% in total votes.
Led the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Datafolha, 47% to 46%, in CNT/MDA, 47.3% to 43.1%, and in AtlasIntel, 47.6% to 47.4%, and tied at 46% in PoderData.
fracos: Falls 20.00pp in the winner contract, to 15.50%, 19.00pp below the recorded low of the series, and Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula goes from 29.05pp to 68.75pp.
Has 45.06% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, behind Flávio Bolsonaro, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied.
In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 03/Oct government approval went from 46% to 44%, with 49% disapproval.
candidates.analise: Lula fell 20.00pp in the winner contract, to 15.50% (vol USD 16.52M cumulative), in the confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, during the count, and 19.94pp normalized; his price stands 19.00pp below the recorded low of the series. 🗳️ In the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT on 04/Oct, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied, Flávio Bolsonaro has 47.12% of the valid votes for president and Lula 45.06%, followed by Augusto Cury, with 2.89%, Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.19%, and Renan Santos, with 2.25%. At 20:58 the TSE marked the presidential result as mathematically defined: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula go to the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), scheduled for 25/Oct (Agência Brasil). In the nine national polls of 03/Oct he led the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in five. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the count or to the polls: it measures the sides with each one's timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 84.25% (vol USD 16.11M cumulative) in the winner contract, up 19.70pp raw and 19.94pp normalized, confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT. COUNT: 47.12% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied. POLL: he led the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the nine national polls of 03/Oct.
fortes: Rises 19.70pp in the winner contract, to 84.25%, 20.95pp above the recorded top of the series, 63.30% on 01/Oct.
Has 47.12% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied.

Led the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in Palver, Futura and both Gerp rounds of 03/Oct, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in Palver, Gerp, Futura and [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest).

⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep the second-round vote transfer from the other names favours him: 81% of Romeu Zema's voters, 48% of Renan Santos's, 42% of Ronaldo Caiado's and 34% of Augusto Cury's would go to him (O Globo).
fracos: Trailed in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in five of the nine national polls of 03/Oct, with the largest margin in CNT/MDA, 38% to 43.1%.

🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Fernando Haddad at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%, confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT. COUNT: Caiado has 2.19% of the valid votes and Zema 0.27% in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, in the confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, with the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT (99.59% of polling sections tallied).

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, with USD 7.81M cumulative. He has 2.19% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT. In the national polls of 03/Oct he ranged from 1% to 4%.
caiado.fortes: Has 2.19% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT. He was third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in Datafolha of 03/Oct, with 4%.
caiado.fracos: Is at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%. In the same reading, the second-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) paid 99.85% for Lula and the third-place book 99.85% for Augusto Cury, the same order as the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) result.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, at the floor of the book, with USD 7.74M cumulative. He is not a presidential candidate: he ran for governor of São Paulo and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no move to explain, and his series high in the winner contract is 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by any of the six national polls of the day nor tested in a [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round. His winner contract has accumulated USD 7.55M, a larger volume than that of Augusto Cury, who is tested by the six houses and has USD 5.02M.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, with USD 7.74M cumulative. He has 0.27% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT.
zema.fortes: ⭐ In [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) of 28/Sep, 81% of his voters would go to Flávio Bolsonaro in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), the largest transfer among the names measured.
zema.fracos: Has 0.27% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, and is at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%.

candidates.analise: Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema and Fernando Haddad are at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%, in the confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT. 🗳️ In the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied, Caiado has 2.19% of the valid votes and Zema 0.27%. Haddad ran for governor of São Paulo, not for president, and lost to Tarcísio de Freitas in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). In the same reading, the second-place book of the first round paid 99.85% for Lula and the third-place book 99.85% for Augusto Cury, the same order as the TSE result.
fortes: ⭐ At Futura on 24/Sep both appear ahead of Lula in a [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing: Ronaldo Caiado by 46.5% to 42.4% and Romeu Zema by 43.8% to 43.3%.
Ronaldo Caiado rose from 4.5% to 5.7% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) of the Futura poll of 24/Sep and passed Augusto Cury.
In the Datafolha state breakdown of 25/Sep, Ronaldo Caiado has 9% in the Federal District and Romeu Zema 4% in Minas Gerais (G1).
fracos: In the same reading, the second-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) paid 99.85% for Lula and the third-place book 99.85% for Augusto Cury, the same order as the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) result.
Fernando Haddad is not a presidential candidate and remains at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%, with USD 7.74M cumulative.

cruzamento: Night of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), count under way. 💹 In the confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 19.70pp in the winner contract, to 84.25%, and Lula falls 20.00pp, to 15.50%, with 19.94pp for each side normalized, and the gap goes from 29.05pp to 68.75pp. Flávio Bolsonaro stands 20.95pp above the recorded top of the series since April 14, 63.30% on 01/Oct, and Lula 19.00pp below the recorded low, 34.50% on 25/Apr. 🗳️ In the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT on 04/Oct, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied, Flávio Bolsonaro has 47.12% of the valid votes for president and Lula 45.06%, followed by Augusto Cury, with 2.89%, Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.19%, and Renan Santos, with 2.25%. At 20:58 the TSE marked the presidential result as mathematically defined: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula go to the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), scheduled for 25/Oct (Agência Brasil). 📊 In the nine national polls released on 03/Oct, the eve of the first round, Lula is ahead in the first round in five (Datafolha, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), PoderData, CNT/MDA and AtlasIntel) and Flávio Bolsonaro in four (Palver, Futura and two from Gerp, which reports that the two measurements share part of the interviews). ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to the count or to the polls: it measures the sides with each one's timestamps.
